records.name: Battle
records.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art game battle sprite sheet with exactly THREE full-body poses in one horizontal row on a truly transparent background.
Input image 1 is the immutable original pose reference: remake the three women in EXACT same left-to-right pose order, viewpoint, left-facing anatomy, arm gestures, clothing construction, silhouette and relative hand/foot positions. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved project's palette and clean pixel-cluster style reference, NOT equipment or anatomy.
Subject: an adult female mage, same woman in all three cells. Long pure solid deep-navy hair flowing to the right/back, short white headband, natural warm skin, clear dark eyes, blue sleeveless long split dress, ivory collar/chest panel and clean ivory edging, modest rose-colored sash as the ONE additional hue. Slender athletic adult build, bare arms and exposed knee where the original split dress opens, dark navy mid-calf boots. No hat, no weapon, no staff, no book, no cape, no new jewelry. Matte materials, no hair glints, no fabric highlights or scattered white speckles.
Pose0: standing in left-facing 3/4 profile, both arms lowered, front leg nearly straight, rear foot slightly back, hair draping down the back. Pose1: same feet and torso, near arm raised straight overhead with open palm, far arm extends horizontally to the right/back, hair blows nearly horizontally right, split skirt flares diagonally left, original gesture must be replicated. Pose2: same feet and torso, one arm extends horizontally to the left in front of face at shoulder height and other forearm folded across chest, hair streams left as in reference, skirt flares left. Preserve hands and head positions shown in reference accurately. Each pose planted on same baseline with same head and waist registration, zero whole-body shifting.
Palette restricted to FIVE visible colors: dark navy #172638 (hair, boots, outlines, shadow), soft medium blue #3976b5, warm ivory #e4e1c8, natural skin #dda77d, muted rose #a9687a. No gray, no additional blue shade, no light shine. Large coherent blue/ivory cloth masses, minimal tidy pixel detail, crisp nearest-neighbor pixel edges, no antialias blur, each character tall enough for a high-detail 4x remaster yet readable at 90px sprite height.
Composition: three separate equal-width cells, full complete figures with generous transparent space between them, no cropped hair/hands/feet. No text, labels, grid, border, glow, shadow on background or spell particles.

records.name: Idle
records.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent pixel-art tactical RPG map idle sprite sheet. Exactly THREE complete separate poses in one horizontal row.
Input image1 is the immutable original native idle poses0,1,2, top row only. Input image2 is the newly approved-for-production design identity/style reference from this task: use the same adult woman, same sleeveless blue split dress, ivory collar/edging, muted rose sash, long solid navy hair and white headband, warm skin, dark eyes, navy boots.
Faithfully translate the original three map idle poses 1:1: preserve each foot, elbow, forearm, skirt direction and the leftward profile/three-quarter orientation. Understand the dark original areas as contour/shadow, the purple as hair/dress, and the original white face/arms as NATURAL SKIN, except actual collar/edging. Do NOT turn the face white. The woman stands looking left, arms held near waist with the forearm positions shifting very slightly, hair and dress flutter subtly to the left as indicated by reference. The original is not a bird beak, not a wide cone hat, not armor. No staff, no weapon, no book.
All three heads, necks, waist centers and support feet must be in exactly the same coordinates relative to their cells: no whole-body bob, no sliding left/right. Actual limb and dress differences only. Full anatomy with both feet and both arms, connected head and neck, visible eye on profile.
Only FIVE colors: #172638 outline/hair/shadow/boots, #3976b5 blue cloth, #e4e1c8 ivory collar/edging, #dda77d skin, #a9687a muted rose sash. Flat solid hair, no brighter hair pixels, matte blue dress with clean large color clusters, no scattered white dots, no shine. Low saturation yet bright and readable. Compact tactical sprite with slightly enlarged head matching reference map proportions, crisp pixel-art contours and tidy clusters. Same woman and same dress in all three, no redesign between cells. Equal cells, baseline and scale; generous transparent padding between figures, fully visible unclipped bodies. True transparent background, no text, labels, grid, shadow, effects or ground.

records.name: Walk
records.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a complete tactical map WALKING sprite sheet for ONE adult female mage, exactly EIGHT figures arranged four columns by two rows on transparent background.
Image1 is the immutable 8-slot original walking anatomy/phase guide. Preserve its order precisely: row1 slots0,1 are UP/BACK two alternating-leg phases; slots2,3 are RIGHT two alternating-leg phases. Row2 slots4,5 are DOWN/FRONT two alternating-leg phases; slots6,7 are LEFT two alternating-leg phases. Image2 is the character identity and garment design reference only.
Same woman throughout: long solid navy hair and small ivory headband, warm natural skin with visible dark eyes, sleeveless blue split long dress with an ivory collar/front panel/clean continuous ivory trim, single muted rose sash, navy mid-calf boots. No hat, weapon, staff, cape, book or armor. Retain original simple costume silhouette and original walking intent.
UP0/1: true back view, back of long hair and shoulders, no face on back, left and right boot alternate support visibly beneath split skirt. RIGHT2/3: true RIGHT profile including face, neck, shoulders, torso, hips and both arms; one boot reaches right while other trails, next phase knee flexes and opposite foot supports, opposite leg must still show its boot. DOWN4/5: true front-facing head with two eyes and face, neck joins body; shoulders level, two alternating boots forward/back. LEFT6/7: true LEFT profile with nose/eye/body left, exact opposite of RIGHT, alternating boots visible.
Pairwise head/neck/torso/waist fixed at exactly same image-relative position; no whole-body bob or lean oscillation. Only natural opposed arm swing, split-dress hem and alternating lower legs move. No disconnected neck, hidden missing feet or identical repeated leg pose. Match reference limb sequence, do not replace it with a generic run.
Five colors only: dark navy #172638 hair/contours/boots/shadow, blue #3976b5, ivory #e4e1c8, skin #dda77d, muted rose #a9687a sash. Hair is ONE FLAT SOLID navy, no glints, clothes matte, no gradients and no scattered white dots. Compact map-sprite proportions, large enough head for clear eyes, clean readable colored clusters, hard crisp pixel-art edges, no antialias softness.
Exactly8 isolated complete full-body figures in evenly spaced equal cells, all same baseline and scale, generous transparent gaps and margins, no figure touching adjacent cells, no text or decorative UI, no ground shadow or effects.

records.name: IdleFix
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the map-idle gestures of image1. This sheet is NOT a battle animation: all three figures need the SAME quiet, small, folded-arm idle stance from image2's native top-row reference.
Keep image1's female character identity, exact head/neck/torso/feet placement, navy hair/headband, blue sleeveless split dress, ivory clean collar/trim, rose sash, skin and navy boots. No weapon or staff.
For ALL THREE figures bend BOTH elbows so hands sit together low in front of the waist/abdomen, forearms crossing lightly near the sash; no arm hanging straight down, no horizontal extended arm and no arm raised. Both legs planted in the same narrow relaxed stance, keep the skirt hanging down in all three (do NOT flare a large diagonal battle skirt). Pose0 hair and skirt hem flutter very slightly one way, pose1 almost neutral, pose2 slightly the other way, only a few pixels difference in silhouette at target sprite scale. The reference has subtle hair/hem and elbow changes, not whole-body posing. Long hair hangs back with a small front wisp on the left, no violent wind.
All three bodies must share identical head, neck, waist, upper torso and foot registration and scale. Preserve clear left-facing side/three-quarter face with eye and skin. Large organized blue/ivory masses and solid one-color navy hair. EXACT palette only #172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #a9687a; no gradients, glints or white noise dots. Compact map pixel-art, crisp hard pixel edges.
Exactly three separate complete figures in one row with equal cells and transparent margins, no text, ground, particles or UI. Transparent background.

records.name: WalkFix
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the WALKING FEET AND ARM PHASES of this eight-figure sheet. Preserve the same woman, exact heads/necks/torso, costume, colors, camera directions, eight-slot order and 4-column x2-row transparent layout.
Main defect: each adjacent pair currently repeats a very similar step. Each pair MUST depict opposite legs supporting and BOTH BOOTS must remain clearly visible.
UP pair top-row first2: first woman LEFT boot planted lower at bottom, RIGHT boot lifted visibly higher beside it; second woman RIGHT boot planted lower at bottom, LEFT boot lifted visibly higher beside it. Make a visible boot on each side of the centerline, at least 10% sprite width apart. No single boot hiding both legs; open split skirt enough to read both. Keep back view, heads and shoulder/waist positions IDENTICAL.
RIGHT pair top-row last2: first pose is OPEN STRIDE, forward/right boot extended right and opposite boot far behind to left. Second pose is CROSSING STEP: one supporting boot directly beneath waist at center, other knee bent with its boot lifted higher BEHIND to the left. Do not show two identical open strides. Swing front bare arm forward in crossing step, backward in open stride, opposite arm contrary. The head, neck, shoulder, torso, waist stay fixed RIGHT profile.
DOWN pair bottom-row first2: true front face and2eyes, first left boot lower/front and right boot raised/back; second right boot lower/front and left boot raised/back, show both feet distinctly each time. Opposed arm swing.
LEFT pair bottom-row last2: mirror the gait geometry of the RIGHT pair: first open stride left, second crossing step with supporting boot centered and rear boot lifted to right. True LEFT head and torso. Both feet visible at all phases.
Keep long hair hanging naturally, same headband, sleeveless blue split dress, ivory collar/front/hem edging, rose sash, natural skin, navy boots. No new clothing or accessories.
Exactly five matte colors only #172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #a9687a. Flat pure navy hair with no gradients or bright highlights. Clean coherent color clusters, crisp pixel edges, no white speckles. Same pairwise head/neck/upper torso and waist, no whole-body sliding/bobbing. Full-body isolated figures with transparent gaps, no text/ground/shadows/effects, truly transparent background.
